How much does it cost to hire a venue in Southwark?

Event venues in Southwark can start at **£20 per hour**, **£25 per person** or **£150 per session**. **Minimum spend** starts at **£150 per session**. (Based on Tagvenue.com platform data)

What are the most popular locations for venue hire in Southwark?

Popular locations for **pub**, **restaurant** and **nightclub** hire can be found around the **London Bridge Underground** station and extend up towards **Bankside**. This central area is popular for after-hours get-togethers. For professional spaces, check around **Southwark Street** and **Borough High Street**. Both areas offer close proximity to the area’s hotels and London’s financial district.

After 2024’s sold out run at the wonderful **St George’s Hall, Liverpool** we are thrilled to be coming back to Liverpool as part of the 2025 UK tour.

Join us to celebrate Baz Luhrmann’s acclaimed 1996 cult classic, screened amongst candle-lit aisles of the opulent and timeless St Georges Hall, where our live choir will performing breath-taking interpretations of iconic songs from the soundtrack, before, during the interval and after the screening. Songs include: Young Hearts, Everybody’s Free, Kissing You, Doves Cry and more.
